3 references
Concept illustration
Primary integration target

Microduck

An upstream biped project selected as SeedCore’s first reference integration. The planned proof point is a short bounded move followed by a stop, with allowed, denied, and interrupted cases.

The pinned Microduck 0.1.0 model package is available for native inspection. Hardware integration and controller qualification remain planned.

Read the upstream project ↗
Concept illustration
Related reference

Reachy Mini

An expressive desktop robot with an upstream SDK and application ecosystem. SeedCore retains earlier Reachy work as an integration reference while Microduck leads the active direction.

Additional hardware rollouts remain deferred in the current SeedCore portfolio.

Read the official docs ↗
Concept illustration
Browser prototype

Two-joint teaching arm

The SeedCore Mini Robot Lab lets you change motor targets, strength, and mass, then replay the calculated response. A useful starting point before more complex bodies.

Fixed-base research model; no robot hardware or collision handling.
